love.summary: Three readers this week sense meaningful relational shifts for Sagittarius — whether reconnecting with someone, deepening a bond, or reopening a closed door, the shared advice is to stay open but move thoughtfully before fully investing your heart.
love.disagreement: Some readers saw Sagittarius becoming more selective and guarded in love, while others suggested opening up and giving someone a second chance.

finance.summary: Most readers see Sagittarius moving toward greater financial stability this week — take time to honestly evaluate your situation, release what undervalues you, and invest disciplined effort in building lasting security.
finance.disagreement: One reading warned of a potential disruptive financial shock, while others focused on steady, gradual improvement and growing clarity.

career.summary: Career shifts and transitions are prominent this week for Sagittarius — whether that means stepping into leadership, recognizing hard-earned progress, or preparing for a bold new chapter, a meaningful professional change appears to be unfolding.
career.disagreement: Some readers saw positive growth through new authority figures, leadership, or earned recognition. Others suggested disillusionment at work or an impending leap into unfamiliar territory, implying less stability ahead.

family.summary: Most readers see this week bringing a meaningful shift in your sense of home and belonging — whether through healing old rifts, joyful reconnection, or moving toward people who truly embrace who you are.
family.disagreement: Some readers emphasized joyful reunions and togetherness within existing relationships, while others focused on stepping away from unsupportive people toward a new, more accepting community.

overall_tone_summary: A bright, forward-looking energy carries Sagittarius through the week with quiet confidence.

readers.channel_theme: A new authority figure may soon lighten your professional load significantly.
You are done tolerating disrespect and are actively preparing to walk away.
A painful relational break may finally be healing, opening the door to reconciliation.
You are moving toward a chosen community that truly celebrates who you are.
A major career leap looms, demanding one careful decision before you jump.
